source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Common Network Security Threats' (PDF 20): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network security ko bohat se threats (khatre) hain. Viruses aur malware (nuqsan deh software) systems ko damage karte (nuqsan pohanchate) hain. Hackers data churane ki koshish karte hain. Phishing (jaali email ya message se dhoka) users ko trick kar ke (dhoka de kar) maloomat share karwati hai. Denial of Service (DoS) attacks (hamle) network services ko rok dete hain. Security tools in threats ko kam karne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Phishing ki misaal: SMS aaye "Aap ka bank account band ho raha hai, is link par apna PIN likhein." Asal bank kabhi PIN nahi maangta; aise link par click na karein.

blocks.prompt: Phishing aur Denial of Service attack mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Phishing dhoke se user se maloomat (password, PIN) nikalwati hai; DoS attack network service par itna bojh daalta hai ke woh ruk jati hai.

items: Khatre: viruses aur malware, hackers, phishing, Denial of Service; security tools inhein kam karte hain.
